name: Eleanor Davies
bio:
Eleanor's journey into motorsport was somewhat unconventional, starting with a degree in organizational psychology and several years in corporate HR before a chance encounter with a racing team owner at a charity event. Intrigued, she volunteered her services initially, quickly proving her ability to navigate the unique challenges of a high-pressure, performance-driven environment. Her transition to a full-time role at Stake Sauber was driven by a desire to implement more structured and supportive HR practices within the team.

Eleanor is known for her pragmatic approach to problem-solving, always seeking practical solutions that benefit both the team and individual employees. She believes in fostering a culture of transparency and open communication, ensuring everyone feels valued and supported. Her focus is on employee well-being and development, aiming to create a sustainable and rewarding career path for all team members.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back in a low ponytail.
physical.description: Eleanor has a kind face framed by auburn hair, with a no-nonsense aura about her.

quirks: Always has a supply of herbal tea in her office.
Has a habit of tapping a pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
